description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git fetch-pack' functionality and related behaviors within the Git version control system. It includes various test cases, setup routines, and validations for features like shallow cloning, object filtering, protocol negotiation, and ref fetching.

methods.name: add
methods.description: A convenience function to create a new commit with specified name and text, update the index, write the tree, and update the branch reference.

methods.name: pull_to_client
methods.description: A function to simulate pulling updates into a client repository, verifying pack count, and updating refs.

methods.name: check_prot_path
methods.description: Validates protocol URL parameters for fetch-pack diagnostics.

methods.name: check_prot_host_port_path
methods.description: Validates protocol URL parameters with host, port, and path for fetch-pack diagnostics.

methods.name: fetch_filter_blob_limit_zero
methods.description: A test routine that sets up repositories to test fetching with a blob size filter limit of zero.
